# origincloud_network_resolver_policy_association (Resource)

The resolver policy a VPC's resolver relays through.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project the resolver policy association is in. Changing it replaces the resolver policy association.
- `region` (String) The region the resolver policy association is in. Changing it replaces the resolver policy association.
- `resolver_policy` (String) The full name of the resolver policy the VPC relays through, in the VPC's project and region. Changing it replaces the resolver policy association.
- `vpc` (String) The vpc the resolver policy association is in. Changing it replaces the resolver policy association.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resolver policy association's full resource name, `//network.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/vpcs/{vpc}/resolverPolicyAssociations/{resolver_policy_association}`: what an argument that refers to the resolver policy association takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the resolver policy's id.
